punch.Name: Bare Fists
punch.Description: Strike with your bare hands. Weak, but better than nothing. Find a weapon.

slash.Name: Slash
slash.Description: Your weapon's basic attack, no mana cost. Quick cuts at the enemy in front of you, three in a row.

strike.Name: Cleave
strike.Description: Cleave through every enemy in a wide arc in front of you. Your greatsword's mana skill; Slash is its free attack.

arcane_bolt.Name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.Description: Your staff's basic attack, no mana cost. A fast bolt of violet arcane force that strikes the first enemy in its path.

zap.Name: Zap
zap.Description: A spell: lightning strikes the enemy from the sky, then chains to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump. Your staff's mana skill; Arcane Bolt is its free attack. (The Lightning and Added Lightning supports put lightning on your other skills.)

ground_slam.Name: Ground Slam
ground_slam.Description: Slam the ground: a shockwave of dust and cracking earth bursts out in a cone in front of you, damaging and staggering every enemy it reaches.

leap_slam.Name: Leap Slam
leap_slam.Description: Leap through the air to the target location and crash down, damaging enemies where you land.

ember_bolt.Name: Ember Bolt
ember_bolt.Description: Hurl a ball of fire that explodes on impact, burning every enemy in the blast.

frost_nova.Name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.Description: Release a ring of frost around you, damaging and chilling every nearby enemy.

arc.Name: Chain Lightning
arc.Description: Lightning leaps from your hand to the nearest enemy, then chains between up to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump.

move.Name: Move
move.Description: Walk towards the cursor, ignoring enemies, items and the portal. Put it on a key as a force move: Left Click still walks and fights.

vow_of_clarity.Name: Vow of Clarity
vow_of_clarity.Description: Swear a Vow of clear thought: you regenerate mana. Reserves a small, flat amount of mana while sworn (it fits an early mana pool). Press again to break it (Vowbreak): for 4 seconds your skills cost no mana, then the Vow cannot be sworn for 10 seconds and you are Forsworn.

vow_of_vigor.Name: Vow of Vigor
vow_of_vigor.Description: Swear a Vow of the living body: you regenerate life, and your attacks gain a little mana on hit. Reserves 20% of your mana while sworn. Vowbreak: heal a quarter of your life at once and regenerate far faster for 4 seconds.

woe_of_withering.Name: Woe of Withering
woe_of_withering.Description: Lay a Woe on every enemy in an area: they take more Poison damage, more damage of every kind and move slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it: the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread (+3% Woe effect per Dread, up to 20). An enemy that dies under it spreads the Woe to 2 nearby enemies. Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

toll_of_dread.Name: Toll of Dread
toll_of_dread.Description: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.

death_sentence.Name: Death Sentence
death_sentence.Description: Sentence one enemy: it takes 25% more damage from everything. Only one enemy can be Sentenced; sentencing another lifts the first. When it dies you gain an Insight charge. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian the Sentence holds until it dies and grows by itself, up to +30% (32.5% more damage taken).

jarls_roar.Name: Jarl's Roar
jarls_roar.Description: A war cry of the old jarls: enemies around you turn on you, and you gain a Resolve charge for each enemy it reaches (up to 3). Resolve: 4% reduced physical damage taken and +4% to elemental resistances per charge.

war_banner_skill.Name: War Banner
war_banner_skill.Description: Plant your War Banner where you aim (up to 8 metres away); use it again to move it. Enemies within 6 metres of the banner take 4% more damage. Every enemy that dies near it adds a Valour (+0.5% more, up to 20); a Rare, Unique or Guardian fighting near it adds one every 2 seconds. Moving the banner keeps half its Valour. Walk away and it falls. An enemy under both your banner and your Hunter's Marks takes only the stronger of the two.

woe_of_cinders.Name: Woe of Cinders
woe_of_cinders.Description: Lay a Woe of Cinders on every enemy in an area: its Fire resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_rime.Name: Woe of Rime
woe_of_rime.Description: Lay a Woe of Rime on every enemy in an area: its Cold resistance falls by 20 and it moves 10% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_the_tempest.Name: Woe of the Tempest
woe_of_the_tempest.Description: Lay a Woe of the Tempest on every enemy in an area: its Lightning resistance falls by 20. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_sundering.Name: Woe of Sundering
woe_of_sundering.Description: Lay a Woe of Sundering on every enemy in an area: it takes 20% more Physical damage. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

woe_of_faltering.Name: Woe of Faltering
woe_of_faltering.Description: Lay a Woe of Faltering on every enemy in an area: its hits deal 20% less damage and it moves 20% slower. Tap to cast it once; HOLD to channel it (the area follows your cursor and each enemy under it gathers Dread, +3% effect per Dread, up to 20). Two Woes per enemy. On a Rare, Unique or Guardian it holds until the enemy dies and grows by itself, up to +30%.

herald_of_embers.Name: Herald of Embers
herald_of_embers.Description: Swear a Herald of fire: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra fire damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into flame: 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life as fire damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Fire and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.

herald_of_rime.Name: Herald of Rime
herald_of_rime.Description: Swear a Herald of cold: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra cold damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills shatter: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life as cold damage within 3 metres (it chills). Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Cold and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.

herald_of_storms.Name: Herald of Storms
herald_of_storms.Description: Swear a Herald of lightning: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra lightning damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills arc to the 3 nearest enemies within 5 metres: 8% of the slain enemy's maximum life as lightning damage. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Lightning and Elemental damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.

herald_of_rot.Name: Herald of Rot
herald_of_rot.Description: Swear a Herald of poison: every hit you deal gains a share of its damage as extra poison damage (10% at gem level 1, 19.5% at 20), and your kills burst into rot: 10% of the slain enemy's maximum life as poison damage within 2.5 metres. Reserves 25% of your mana while sworn. Press again to break it (Vowbreak): the extra damage is 2.5 times as strong for 4 seconds, then the Herald cannot be sworn for 10 seconds. Scales with: the hit's own skill modifiers and your Poison damage. Does not scale with: the kill effect, it is always a share of the slain enemy's life.

storm_whirl.Name: Storm Whirl
storm_whirl.Description: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.

flame_dash.Name: Flame Dash
flame_dash.Description: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds.

winter_orb.Name: Winter Orb
winter_orb.Description: Conjure an orb of ice by your shoulder for 6 seconds. It hurls icicles at nearby enemies, then shatters in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. Casting again shatters the old orb at once.

storm_brand.Name: Storm Spark
storm_brand.Description: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 5 seconds; up to 3 sparks at once, so longer lasting sparks keep more of them crawling. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

ember_spark.Name: Ember Spark
ember_spark.Description: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never jumps: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 6 seconds; up to 3 sparks at once. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

rime_spark.Name: Rime Spark
rime_spark.Description: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds it strikes its host with frost that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 5 seconds; up to 3 sparks at once. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

venom_spark.Name: Venom Spark
venom_spark.Description: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds it strikes its host and {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts 7 seconds; up to 3 sparks at once. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

reap.Name: Reap
reap.Description: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.

death_coil.Name: Death Coil
death_coil.Description: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.

summon_skeletons.Name: Summon Skeletons
summon_skeletons.Description: Raise skeleton warriors from the ground: two, and one more every fifth gem level. They follow you and fight until they fall.

summon_skeletal_mage.Name: Summon Skeletal Mage
summon_skeletal_mage.Description: Raise skeletal mages that keep their distance and hurl bolts of dark magic at your foes: one, two from gem level 9, three from gem level 17. They stay until they fall.

drain_life.Name: Drain Life
drain_life.Description: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A fifth of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.

vampire_dash.Name: Vampire Dash
vampire_dash.Description: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it.

summon_bone_golem.Name: Grave Golem
summon_bone_golem.Description: Tear a golem of grave-fire out of the earth. It is enormous, soaks up blows meant for you and smashes the ground around it; it burns in the colour of its supports' element. Only one answers at a time. Each golem blesses those near it: the grave golem heals you 1% of your life a second, the flame golem gives your minions 12.5% more damage, the ice golem gives you 31% more armour, the storm golem makes your minions 15% faster, and the venom golem makes enemies take 7.5% more damage. The golem grows with your level: the deeper the Ruptures, the harder it hits.

summon_zombie.Name: Raise Zombie
summon_zombie.Description: Drag a zombie up out of the ground: two stand at once, three from gem level 16, four from gem level 24. Zombies stay until they fall, grow with the gem, hit hard and every fourth blow slams the ground round their foe. Supports such as Brutality or Flame make them brutal or burning.

grave_call.Name: Grave Call
grave_call.Description: Call every minion you have to your side. They come running (those far away step out of the ground beside you) and close in round you, then fight on with 30% more damage, moving and attacking 20% faster, for 4 seconds.

unholy_void.Name: Unholy Void
unholy_void.Description: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.

hammer_blow.Name: Hammer Blow
hammer_blow.Description: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.

holy_slash.Name: Holy Slash
holy_slash.Description: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.

judgement.Name: Judgement
judgement.Description: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. {Projectiles} {Projectiles}|plural(one=bolt,other=bolts); one more at gem levels 10 and 20.

orbiting_hammers.Name: Orbiting Hammers
orbiting_hammers.Description: Turn on a ring of {OrbitCount} spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.

hammerstorm.Name: Hammerstorm
hammerstorm.Description: Swear the hammers to the storm: for 5 seconds your spinning hammers turn half again as fast, reach 35% farther, hit 40% harder and three more hammers join them in a second ring. If no hammers are spinning, it calls them.

consecrated_ground.Name: Consecrated Ground
consecrated_ground.Description: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.

holy_charge.Name: Holy Charge
holy_charge.Description: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

summon_holy_elemental.Name: Holy Elemental
summon_holy_elemental.Description: Call down a Holy Elemental of living light. It fights at your side, smashing your foes with blows of holy light that strike everything around them, until it is destroyed. A second elemental answers at gem level 10. Its light shelters you: within 9 metres of it you have +6% chance to block and regenerate 0.5% of your life a second. Shared Light: past 4 elementals, each deals 4% less per extra elemental standing (12: 32% less each). The army never shrinks, only the blow each one lands.

pyre_of_faith.Name: Pyre of Faith
pyre_of_faith.Description: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out.

quick_shot.Name: Quick Shot
quick_shot.Description: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.

power_shot.Name: Piercing Shot
power_shot.Description: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.

split_shot.Name: Split Shot
split_shot.Description: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.

arrow_rain.Name: Rain of Arrows
arrow_rain.Description: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times.

wind_vault.Name: Wind Vault
wind_vault.Description: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks.

lightning_arrow.Name: Lightning Arrow
lightning_arrow.Description: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to {Chains} more {Chains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) for 60% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown.

summon_ballista.Name: Ballista
summon_ballista.Description: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support and the passive tree add more, and every one you add counts. Supports on this gem change its bolts.

twin_cuts.Name: Twin Cuts
twin_cuts.Description: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.

flurry.Name: Flurry
flurry.Description: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.

iaido_thrust.Name: Iaido Thrust
iaido_thrust.Description: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

crescent_slash.Name: Crescent Slash
crescent_slash.Description: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.

shuriken_fan.Name: Shuriken Fan
shuriken_fan.Description: Flick a fan of {Projectiles} spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through {Pierce} {Pierce}|plural(one=foe,other=foes) before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.

blade_vortex.Name: Blade Vortex
blade_vortex.Description: {OrbitCount} spectral {OrbitCount}|plural(one=blade joins,other=blades join) a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to {OrbitMax} blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.

thousand_cuts.Name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.Description: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill: movement supports, passives and items apply (it is still a melee attack, not your dash).

sheathe.Name: Sheathe
sheathe.Description: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of the cut that marked it, and half of that to everything around it. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.

cyclone.Name: Cyclone
cyclone.Description: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.

shield_charge.Name: Shield Charge
shield_charge.Description: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.

earthshatter.Name: Earthshatter
earthshatter.Description: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.

chain.Name: Chain
chain.Description: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump deals a tenth less damage. 5% less damage.

multiple_projectiles.Name: Multiple Projectiles
multiple_projectiles.Description: Fires 2 additional projectiles in a fan. 15% less damage. Each enemy is hit by one projectile per cast; the extras hit the pack behind.

concentrated.Name: Concentrated Effect
concentrated.Description: 30% less area of effect. 35% more damage.

added_lightning.Name: Added Lightning
added_lightning.Description: Adds 1 to 6 lightning damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage.

added_poison.Name: Added Poison
added_poison.Description: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. The skill's poison damage penetrates 10% poison resistance. Supports Attack and Spell skills: any hit with poison damage can poison. Supported skills' poisons, bleeds and ignites deal 40% less damage. On a minion skill its minions' hits carry it at half strength.

added_fire.Name: Added Fire
added_fire.Description: Gain 30% of physical damage as extra fire damage. It counts the physical left after conversion, so it adds less with Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked.

elemental_focus.Name: Elemental Focus
elemental_focus.Description: 30% more elemental damage. Damage converted to Fire, Cold or Lightning (Flame, Ice, Lightning) counts as elemental too.

toxic_focus.Name: Toxic Focus
toxic_focus.Description: 25% more poison damage: poison hits and the poisons they apply. Damage converted to Poison (Venom) counts as poison too.

faster_attacks.Name: Faster Attacks
faster_attacks.Description: 25% more attack speed. On a summon: its minions attack 25% faster.

penetration.Name: Elemental Penetration
penetration.Description: Hits ignore 20% of enemy elemental resistance.

life_leech.Name: Life Leech
life_leech.Description: 1% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life.

brutality.Name: Brutality
brutality.Description: 35% more physical damage, and attacks get another 7.4% more on top (about 45% in all). Minions get the 35%. Deals no elemental damage. Linked with Lightning, Flame or Ice, the converted share is lost.

pierce.Name: Pierce
pierce.Description: Projectiles pierce 2 additional targets. 10% less damage.

spell_echo.Name: Spell Echo
spell_echo.Description: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. On a channel it adds an echo pulse every 2nd tick at 90% of the hit. An echoed curse is 20% stronger and an echoed war cry's Resolve lasts 1 second longer. Never repeats a dash, a Vow or a toggle like Orbiting Hammers.

melee_physical.Name: Melee Physical Damage
melee_physical.Description: 40% more melee physical damage. 10% less attack speed. Works on melee minions. It scales only the physical left after conversion.

controlled_destruction.Name: Controlled Destruction
controlled_destruction.Description: 40% more spell damage. -40% to Critical Strike Multiplier. 10% less cast speed.

bloodbound.Name: Bloodbound
bloodbound.Description: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (20% more cost). The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.

siphon.Name: Siphon
siphon.Description: 2% of the linked skill's damage is leeched as life; attacks also leech 1% as mana. A totem's hits leech at 30% of that.

tithe.Name: Tithe
tithe.Description: Every hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana (attacks) and every kill 6 mana (spells, attacks and the kills of a linked summon's minions).

woebringer.Name: Woebringer
woebringer.Description: The linked Woe becomes an aura around you: while sworn it reserves 30% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 metres (Dread grows while they stay in it). Press the skill again to end it.

pass_sentence.Name: Pass Sentence
pass_sentence.Description: When the Sentenced enemy dies, the Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy (else the nearest enemy) within 10 metres.

gather_fury.Name: Gather Fury
gather_fury.Description: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (at most one every half second). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed per charge. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the charge.

bloodlust_support.Name: Bloodlust
bloodlust_support.Description: Each kill with the linked skill grants 1 stack of Bloodlust: 0.6% more damage for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the stack.

war_banner_support.Name: War Banner
war_banner_support.Description: Retired: the War Banner is now a skill gem of its own. Any War Banner support you had became the War Banner skill gem.

hunters_mark_support.Name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark_support.Description: Each hit with the linked skill puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: it takes 1.4% more damage for each Mark, up to 10, twice as many on a Guardian or a Unique. The Marks fall off 3 seconds after your last hit, so keep shooting. Marks and your War Banner do not add up: an enemy takes the stronger of the two. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

woe_bearer.Name: Woe Bearer
woe_bearer.Description: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits strike takes it too, while it has room for another Woe (it never replaces one). The Woe can still be cast. Two Woe Bearers work at once.

totem_support.Name: Spell Totem
totem_support.Description: The spell is no longer cast by you: casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. 25% less damage.

multiple_totems.Name: Multiple Totems
multiple_totems.Description: You may have 2 additional totems or ballistas of the supported skill at once. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 8 Ballistas and 12 Totems.

bone_guard.Name: Bone Guard
bone_guard.Description: Minions from the supported skill stay close and take on what comes at you. They have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% of their life per second. While one stands within 9 metres, you have 30% more armour plus 10 armour per level, and regenerate 1% of your life per second.

ravening_host.Name: Ravening Host
ravening_host.Description: Minions from the supported skill range ahead of you and hunt, engaging enemies 50% farther away. They deal 25% more damage and move, attack and cast 15% faster.

zap_support.Name: Lightning
zap_support.Description: Turns the skill to lightning: 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage is converted to Lightning (Poison at half: 30%). Hits shock; a spinning attack calls lightning down from the sky onto the enemies it cuts. (Not the Zap spell: Zap is a skill gem of its own.) Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

flame_support.Name: Flame
flame_support.Description: 60% of Physical, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Fire (Poison at half: 30%). Hits ignite. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

ice_support.Name: Ice
ice_support.Description: 60% of Physical, Fire and Lightning damage is converted to Cold (Poison at half: 30%). Hits chill; chilled kills shatter. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

venom_support.Name: Venom
venom_support.Description: 60% of Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Poison. +25% chance to Poison. Poison hits ignore 15% of Poison resistance. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

skyfall.Name: Skyfall
skyfall.Description: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. On Earthshatter a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells and projectile attacks can fall; each enemy is struck once per use. Spells deal 20% more damage. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain, Trap or Totem also socketed, the first one socketed is used (a Totem or Trap always places it) and Skyfall adds only its damage. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling.

tether.Name: Tether
tether.Description: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds; linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second.

swift_step.Name: Swift Step
swift_step.Description: The movement skill has a 40% shorter cooldown and deals 20% more damage.

channel_conduit.Name: Channel Conduit
channel_conduit.Description: While you channel, your linked spell casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for half its mana cost, with this skill's other supports. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. 30% more channelling cost. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

honed_edge.Name: Honed Edge
honed_edge.Description: +1% to base Critical Strike Chance and 80% increased Critical Strike Chance. Best on a build that already raises its critical strikes. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

deathblow.Name: Deathblow
deathblow.Description: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier: critical strikes hit much harder. Best with Honed Edge or other critical strike chance. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

orbit.Name: Orbit
orbit.Description: The skill's projectiles first circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (a bow's arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile. At most 8 projectiles circle at once: more are lost. Every projectile strikes; one sent at an enemy this cast already struck deals 60% less damage (an arrow or thrown blade 90% less: spread them over a pack). A skill takes one shape: Orbit keeps it circling even with Meteor Lore (the fall gives way), and with another shape gem socketed the first one socketed is used.

channel_mastery.Name: Unbroken Channel
channel_mastery.Description: Up to 25% more damage, ramping in over the first second of channelling. 20% less channelling cost.

minion_damage.Name: Minion Damage
minion_damage.Description: Minions from the supported skill deal 40% more damage.

minion_life.Name: Minion Life
minion_life.Description: Minions from the supported skill have 60% more life.

minion_speed.Name: Minion Speed
minion_speed.Description: Minions from the supported skill move, attack and cast 25% faster.

fork.Name: Fork
fork.Description: Projectiles fork into two on hitting an enemy: each flies on to either side for 70% of the hit.

rain_support.Name: Rain
rain_support.Description: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside twice (three times with 4 or more projectiles). 40% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice.

trap_support.Name: Trap
trap_support.Description: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). It is live the moment it lands and goes off the instant an enemy comes within 4 metres; its first strike deals 100% more damage, then it re-arms a moment later. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. 50% more damage.

afterimage.Name: Afterimage
afterimage.Description: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage.

affliction_support.Name: Affliction
affliction_support.Description: +25% chance to Ignite and +25% chance to Poison. 50% increased Burning and Poison damage. 15% less damage with hits.

stormfrost_support.Name: Stormfrost
stormfrost_support.Description: +25% chance to Shock and 50% increased effect of Shock. Cold hits build up Freeze 60% faster.

repeat_support.Name: Repeat
repeat_support.Description: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 40% less damage.

cast_on_crit.Name: Cast on Crit
cast_on_crit.Description: When one of your attacks lands a critical hit, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the enemy struck, at most once every 0.15 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 25% less damage. In an attack instead, drop a spell on its link and that attack's crits cast the linked spell. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.

cast_when_hit.Name: Cast when Hit
cast_when_hit.Description: Each time you have taken damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the attacker, at most once every 0.5 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 10% less damage. In an attack, or to cast another spell, drop a spell on its link. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.

cast_on_minion_death.Name: Cast on Minion Death
cast_on_minion_death.Description: When a minion from this skill dies, your linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once every 0.4 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost and with this skill's other supports. The linked spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. One link per skill: the first linking support socketed works. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

rend.Name: Rend
rend.Description: Physical hits of this skill have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 50% of the hit's physical damage each second for 4 seconds (the strongest bleed holds; 50% more while the enemy moves). 60% more Bleeding damage. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

deep_wounds.Name: Deep Wounds
deep_wounds.Description: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal 40% more damage. Hits are unchanged. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

living_storm.Name: Gathering Storm
living_storm.Description: This skill's Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 60% more damage taken. +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

contagion_flame.Name: Contagious Flame
contagion_flame.Description: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads (100% chance) to enemies within 4.5 metres. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

shatter.Name: Shatter
shatter.Description: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 8% of their maximum Life as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them. 20% increased effect of Chill. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

melee_splash.Name: Melee Splash
melee_splash.Description: Every blow splashes: enemies within 2 metres of each enemy struck take 55% of the blow's damage (once per blow). 10% less damage. Works on minions: their blows splash too.

multistrike.Name: Multistrike
multistrike.Description: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times and every strike deals 48% of the damage (52% less). Works on minions: each of their blows strikes 2 more times.

maim.Name: Maim
maim.Description: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 seconds: it moves 30% slower and takes 10% more Physical damage from you, your minions and your allies. 8% more Physical damage. Works on minions.

ruthless.Name: Ruthless
ruthless.Description: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.

executioner.Name: Executioner
executioner.Description: 25% more damage against enemies below 35% of their life, and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Works with bows and on minions.

vicious_projectiles.Name: Vicious Projectiles
vicious_projectiles.Description: 40% more Physical damage with projectiles, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts: it adds nothing to damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked). On a summon it fits minions that shoot, at half strength.

added_cold.Name: Added Cold
added_cold.Description: Adds 3 to 4 cold damage to spells and attacks, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. Steadier than Added Lightning (1 to 6) for the same average, and it chills.

chain_detonation.Name: Chain Detonation
chain_detonation.Description: Supports skills thrown as Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby, one after another. Traps set each other off at 100% more distance, and each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 to the maximum number of Traps.

projectile_n0.Name: Fletcher's Focus
projectile_n0.Text: Enemies your Projectiles kill, your Ballistas' bolts too, burst into splinters: 10% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

evasion_n0.Name: Fleet Shadow
evasion_n0.Text: When your roll ends, the wind cuts around you: 30% of your last skill's hit to enemies within 2.5 metres (once every 2 seconds).

edge_n0.Name: Endless Edge
edge_n0.Text: Every fifth Melee hit cuts again: 20% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

mirrorblade_n0.Name: Second Shadow
mirrorblade_n0.Text: Your melee Movement skills (Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Iaido Thrust) strike again where they land: a shadow repeats the hit, and both hits deal 20% less damage. Dashes and Cyclone are not changed.

mirrorblade_c1.Name: Echo Cut
mirrorblade_c1.Text: Works on dashes: Iaido Thrust, Holy Charge, Shield Charge, Leap Slam and Wind Vault. Never on channelled skills such as Cyclone. Why: Afterimage and Spell Echo already echo your other attacks and spells, but they cannot echo a dash. This altar is the dash's echo.

stillness_n1.Name: Iaijutsu
stillness_n1.Text: Dashes: Iaido Thrust, Shield Charge, Holy Charge, Leap Slam, Wind Vault and the blinks. Channelled skills such as Cyclone are not dashes.

elemental_overload.Name: Elemental Overload
elemental_overload.Text: Critical strikes grant 40% more elemental damage for 8 seconds.

twice_fallen_sky.Name: Twice-Fallen Sky
twice_fallen_sky.Text: Every Skyfall strike falls twice: a second impact 0.4 seconds later for 60% of the damage.
twice_fallen_sky.Price: Skyfall skills cost 50% more mana and have 20% less area.

glass_cannon.Name: Glass Cannon
glass_cannon.Price: You cannot Evade. You cannot Leech Life. You take 15% increased Damage.

blood_magic.Name: Blood Magic
blood_magic.Text: Skills cost Life instead of Mana.

lord_of_the_dead.Name: Lord of the Dead
lord_of_the_dead.Text: +1 to the maximum number of each kind of minion.
lord_of_the_dead.Price: Your Vows reserve 40% more Mana. 10% less maximum Life.

pyre_covenant.Name: Pyre Covenant
pyre_covenant.Text: Your minions explode on death for 15% of their maximum Life as Fire damage to enemies within 2.5 metres.

cascade_of_ruin.Name: Cascade of Ruin
cascade_of_ruin.Text: Deaths spread: every shatter, burn to ash, electrocution or death by Poison deals 8% of the victim's Life as its element to enemies within 2.5 metres.

eagle_eye.Name: Eagle Eye
eagle_eye.Price: You cannot deal critical strikes with spells.

chain_reaction.Name: Chain Reaction
chain_reaction.Price: 40% less damage to the first target hit.

thousand_hands.Name: Thousand Hands
thousand_hands.Text: 15% more Attack Speed while Dual Wielding, and 15% more with Fists and Claws. 0.6% of Melee damage is Leeched as Life. Every eighth Melee hit releases a ring of blades: 40% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.
thousand_hands.Price: -6% to maximum Fire, Cold and Lightning Resistances.

way_of_the_blade.Name: Way of the Blade
way_of_the_blade.Text: Your melee attacks repeat once. Channelled skills such as Cyclone never repeat.

one_breath.Name: One Breath
one_breath.Text: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier. Your Attack critical strikes cut again: 25% of the hit to enemies within 2 metres (at most twice a second).
one_breath.Price: 20% less Attack Speed. Your Spells cannot deal critical strikes.

unbroken_wall.Name: Unbroken Wall
unbroken_wall.Text: +10% Chance to Block while holding a Shield. Your Attacks deal 20% more damage while you hold a Shield, and Shield skills 15% more on top. When you Block, the shield strikes back: 40% of your last skill's hit as Physical damage to enemies within 2 metres (once a second).
unbroken_wall.Price: You cannot Evade and your maximum Elemental Resistances are 3% lower: the wall turns blows, not the storm.

wake_of_spells.Name: Wake of Spells
wake_of_spells.Text: All your Channelling skills are supported by Channel Conduit, which casts twice as often: your spin leaves a wake of your linked spell.
wake_of_spells.Price: Conduit spells deal 10% less damage. Channelling costs 30% more.

iron_resolve.Name: Iron Resolve
iron_resolve.Text: Armour mitigates elemental hits at half value.

spellblade.Name: Spellblade
spellblade.Text: Spell damage modifiers also apply to attacks.

sanctified.Name: Sanctified
sanctified.Text: Gain 20% of Physical Damage as extra Fire Damage. 30% more Damage with Holy Spells.
sanctified.Price: 20% less Attack Damage. Your Spells cost 25% more Mana.

ancestral_host.Name: Ancestral Host
ancestral_host.Text: +2 to the maximum number of Ballistas and Totems. Your Ballistas and Totems have 40% increased Life.
ancestral_host.Price: You deal no damage with skills you use yourself (totems, minions and conduits still do).

hollow_covenant.Name: Hollow Covenant
hollow_covenant.Text: Regenerate 0.1% of Life per second for every 1% of uncapped Poison Resistance.
hollow_covenant.Price: -8% to maximum Fire and Lightning Resistances. You cannot leech Life.

siege_pact.Name: Siege Pact
siege_pact.Text: +1 to the maximum number of Ballistas and Totems. Your Ballistas and Totems fire an extra projectile.

forked_sky.Name: Forked Sky
forked_sky.Text: Your projectiles Fork once when they hit.

tempest_vow.Name: Tempest Vow
tempest_vow.Text: Your Channelling skills are supported by Lightning and Tether: your spin calls lightning down onto what it cuts, and every enemy it hits is linked to 2 more.

hammer_of_judgement.Name: Hammer of Judgement
hammer_of_judgement.Text: Every second Slam calls 3 Sky Swords down where it lands, each dealing 55% of the Slam's hit (once every 0.6 seconds).

dawnstorm_covenant.Name: Dawnstorm Covenant
dawnstorm_covenant.Text: Your Spell critical strikes call a pillar of dawn onto the enemy for 45% of the hit (each enemy at most once a second).

choir_of_bones.Name: Choir of Bones
choir_of_bones.Text: Your Minions' Projectile skills are supported by Chain: every Skeletal Mage bolt leaps to 2 more enemies.

the_hunting_dead.Name: The Hunting Dead
the_hunting_dead.Text: Your Minions range ahead and hunt (Ravening Host). Enemies you kill with Projectiles (Rain of Arrows is not one) burst in a plague cloud: 30% of the killing hit as Poison damage within 2.5 metres.

wind_and_steel_oath.Name: Oath of Wind and Steel
wind_and_steel_oath.Text: Your Melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing (Afterimage). Your Bow attacks Fork.

earthbreaker_stride.Name: Earthbreaker Stride
earthbreaker_stride.Text: Your Movement skills end in an eruption: 5 spikes break the ground under enemies within 3.5 metres for 50% of the skill's hit (once a second).

aegis_rebuke.Name: Aegis Rebuke
aegis_rebuke.Text: When you Block, holy fire bursts from you: 60% of your last skill's hit as Fire damage to enemies within 3 metres (once every 0.8 seconds).

comet_step.Name: Comet Step
comet_step.Text: Your roll ends in a burst of dawn-fire: 60% of your last skill's hit as Fire damage to enemies within 3 metres (once every 1.5 seconds).
comet_step.Price: 15% reduced Energy Shield. 8% reduced maximum Life.

radiant_crusade.Name: Radiant Crusade
radiant_crusade.Text: Every third Holy Melee hit calls a pillar of dawn onto the enemy for 50% of the hit (each enemy at most once a second).

rotting_gospel.Name: Rotting Gospel
rotting_gospel.Text: Every fourth Poison Spell hit bursts: 40% of the hit as Poison damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. 20% more Damage with Poison Spells. 20% increased Effect of your Curses.

r59_sure_strike_k3.Name: Sure Strike
r59_sure_strike_k3.Text: Your Melee skills deal 15% more Physical damage. Every Melee hit shakes the ground: 50% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.
r59_sure_strike_k3.Price: Your Attacks cannot deal critical strikes. 10% less Attack Speed.

r59_mountain_k3.Name: Mountainborn
r59_mountain_k3.Text: Every 10 Strength also gives you 1% more Melee Physical damage.

r59_hold_k3.Name: The Long Hunt
r59_hold_k3.Text: While an enemy you Sentenced is alive, your Bloodlust does not run out.
r59_hold_k3.Price: 10 less maximum Bloodlust. Your Bloodlust runs out 30% sooner.

r60_cross60_n3.Name: Frost of the Grave
r60_cross60_n3.Text: When one of your minions falls, it bursts in frost: half of your last skill's hit to enemies within 2.5 metres (once every 0.5 seconds).

r60_cross0_n3.Name: Blight Hunter
r60_cross0_n3.Text: Enemies your Projectiles kill burst in poison: 30% of that hit to enemies within 2.5 metres.

r60_cross300_n3.Name: Edge of the Wind
r60_cross300_n3.Text: When your roll ends, the wind cuts around you: half of your last skill's hit to enemies within 3 metres (once every 1.5 seconds).

r60_cross240_n3.Name: Blood and Steel
r60_cross240_n3.Text: When an enemy hits you, your blade answers: 60% of your last skill's hit to enemies within 2.5 metres (once a second).

r60_cross180_n3.Name: Burning Crusade
r60_cross180_n3.Text: Every sixth Melee hit bursts in holy fire: 40% of that hit to enemies within 2.5 metres.

r60_cross120_n3.Name: Stormblade
r60_cross120_n3.Text: Every fourth Melee hit calls lightning down: 35% of that hit to enemies within 2 metres.

r60_socket_0.Name: Dwarven Rune Socket
r60_socket_0.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.

r60_socket_1.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.

r60_socket_5.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.

r60_socket_6.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.

r60_socket_7.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.

r60_socket_8.Name: Dwarven Rune Socket
r60_socket_8.Text: An empty Dwarven Rune Socket. From Rupture Level 110 you can set a Dwarven Rune here, and swap it for free.

oath_of_the_long_night.Name: Oath of the Long Night
oath_of_the_long_night.Text: Every third Cold hit bursts into frost: 40% of the hit as Cold damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. 15% more Cold Damage. 30% increased chill and freeze build-up.

oath_of_the_pyre.Name: Oath of the Pyre
oath_of_the_pyre.Text: Every fourth hit against a Burning enemy bursts: 40% of the hit as Fire damage to enemies within 2.5 metres. +10% chance to Ignite. 40% increased Burning damage.

oath_of_the_snare.Name: Oath of the Snare
oath_of_the_snare.Text: Your Traps deal 25% more Damage, strike 25% wider and have 50% increased Critical Chance.

oath_of_the_living_storm.Name: Oath of the Living Storm
oath_of_the_living_storm.Text: Your Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 60% more damage taken. When a Shocked enemy dies, its Shock has a 50% chance to spread to enemies within 4.5 metres. +15% chance to Shock.

oath_of_many_fires.Name: Oath of Many Fires
oath_of_many_fires.Text: Your Ignites stack: 3 more Ignites burn on an enemy at once (4 in all). When a Burning enemy dies, its Ignite has a 50% chance to spread to enemies within 4.5 metres.

oath_of_the_white_silence.Name: Oath of the White Silence
oath_of_the_white_silence.Text: Chilled and Frozen enemies you kill shatter for 10% of their maximum Life as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them. 40% increased effect of Chill. 40% increased Freeze duration.
oath_of_the_white_silence.Price: Your hits cannot Ignite or Shock.

oath_of_the_red_harvest.Name: Oath of the Red Harvest
oath_of_the_red_harvest.Text: Your Physical hits always cause Bleeding. 30% more Bleeding damage. +15% to Damage over Time Multiplier.

oath_of_a_thousand_cuts.Name: Oath of a Thousand Cuts
oath_of_a_thousand_cuts.Text: +50% chance to cause Bleeding with Physical hits. +30% to Damage over Time Multiplier.
oath_of_a_thousand_cuts.Price: Your Attacks cannot deal critical strikes.

oath_of_slow_ruin.Name: Oath of Slow Ruin
oath_of_slow_ruin.Text: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier: your Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal 40% more damage.

r74_bone_sovereign.Name: Bone Sovereign
r74_bone_sovereign.Text: +1 to the maximum number of each of your minions. Your minions deal 30% more damage.

r79_intstack_k0.Name: Boundless Mind
r79_intstack_k0.Text: Every 10 Intelligence also gives you 1% more Spell damage.
